'''Prow''' was a type of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]]. [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] once requested prow at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Bounty" /> Ventress ordered the drink "''Straight up'' implying the drink could be mixed to make cocktails.
